Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in analyzing the WebSurfer's results for "Les Résultats du féminisme." The Planner incorrectly stated that the release year of "Les Résultats du féminisme" was 2006, when the WebSurfer's findings clearly indicated that the film was released in 1906. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion that "Out of the Rain" (1991) came out earlier than "Les Résultats du féminisme" (1906), which is factually incorrect. This error directly impacted the final solution to the real-world problem.
